label: NIS2 Article 23 incident reporting
statusNote: A directive: national transpositions may shorten deadlines (for example 24 hours for trust service providers), so a pack per member state can override this record.

triggers.label: Became aware of a significant incident

clocks.label: Early warning
clocks.rule: Without undue delay and within 24 hours of becoming aware of the significant incident.

clocks.label: Incident notification
clocks.rule: Without undue delay and within 72 hours of becoming aware, with an initial assessment.

clocks.label: Final report
clocks.rule: No later than one month after the incident notification.

appliesTo.note: Essential and important entities under NIS2.
